paragraphs: The F-Type R uses the AJ133 — a 5.0-litre supercharged V8 that's been the top performance engine in Jaguar's line-up for years. It was fitted from 2013 to 2024 across the X152 generation, though the earlier 2012–2014 cars are the ones covered by the US class-action lawsuit over timing chain tensioner and guide wear. Later cars share the same engine code but received updated tensioner and guide components, so the lawsuit-scoped claim is specifically limited to the earlier build years — though we always inspect the full timing assembly on every AJ133 rebuild regardless of the car's age.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ133 engines for every F-Type R on the road.

cards.body: A 5.0-litre supercharged V8 fitted to the F-Type R from 2013 to 2024 (X152). Known for timing chain tensioner and guide wear on 2012–2014 models — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, guides and water pump as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.
